newsitem.title: JAPAN: Britain on track to reach inflation target--Clarke.
newsitem.headline: Britain on track to reach inflation target--Clarke.

text.p: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke told reporters on Thursday that Britain was on course to achieve its inflation target.
"At the moment, we are well on course to have a good level of growth next year and achieve our inflation target," he said after meeting his Japanese counterpart.
He said he will continue to adopt policies to achieve that target. "I shall only do that at the proper time, having looked at all the data," he said.
Britain is now enjoying steady growth and low inflation, and has adopted a near-term inflation target of 2.5 percent.
Clarke arrived in Japan on Wednesday for talks with senior Japanese officials.
